statuses.independent: An unaffiliated operator can run the role from this repository with open-source dependencies only, and no default endpoint is required.
statuses.partial: An independent profile serves part of the role; the listed gaps still need the hosted deployment.
statuses.hosted-only: The role runs only on the hosted deployment today; the listed gaps say what is missing.

failureVerdicts.pass: Every contract check answered as specified.
failureVerdicts.degraded: Every check that did not pass answered with the role's declared explicit degradation (for example 503 with a machine-readable error). Canonical data is untouched.
failureVerdicts.fail: At least one check answered outside both the contract and the declared degradation.
failureVerdicts.unreachable: The role did not answer at all. Clients must treat this as service loss, never as an empty result.

roles.label: Web UI
roles.summary: Browse repositories, files, history, pull requests, issues, and projects in a browser.

required.note: Any TLS-terminating proxy (Caddy, nginx, HAProxy) in front of the loopback listener.

optional.substitute: Set disableCloudflared and publish the origin through the operator's own HTTPS reverse proxy.
Omit dashboard.canonicalOrigin: /login and /signup are not redirected, and the dashboard stays signed out except for portable sessions the router key already signed.

roles.canonicalData: None. Pages and assets are Git blobs from the mirrored assets repository; the gateway stores no page state.
observability: structured gateway access log on stderr
roles.failure: Losing the hosted Worker leaves the dashboard serving the last validated public projection from dashboard.replicaPath; losing the gateway makes /health unreachable and the stable clone URL fails over to another healthy mirror.
gaps: Account signup, password login, and every write form still require the hosted Worker.
The Worker itself depends on Cloudflare Workers, D1, Durable Objects, KV, and Queues; there is no packaged, tested workerd profile.

roles.label: Repository relay and clone routing
roles.summary: Serve stock Git clones and fetches, route the stable repository URL to a healthy copy, and notify nodes when refs change.

hosted.implementation: Python Worker edge routing and ForkMeshNodes Durable Object

independentProfile.implementation: Mirror gateway Smart HTTP plus forkmesh-mirror-node synchronization

optional.substitute: Ref changes arrive through the post-receive doorbell (POST /v1/control/sync) and direct peer upstreams; third-party upstreams use syncInterval.
Pass --disable-cloudflared with an operator HTTPS origin.

roles.canonicalData: Git objects and refs in the node's bare repositories, pinned by the signed refs digest.
roles.failure: Without the hosted relay, existing clones and fetches keep working against the gateway's own origin; the stable forkmesh.com URL cannot redirect to it.
gaps: Stable-URL routing across independent operators and the node event socket have no self-hostable implementation.
A repository needs a signed refs pin that the hosted control plane issues before its stable URL routes.

roles.label: Public repository index
roles.summary: List public repositories with their clone endpoints and maintainers.

optional.substitute: Set disableCatalog in the mirror-node configuration, or point --catalog-url at another operator's catalog.

roles.canonicalData: None. Catalog rows are signed, republished projections of repository state on each node.
roles.failure: A node's own catalog keeps listing its repositories; the network-wide list is lost with the hosted Worker, and clients must show it as unavailable rather than empty.
gaps: Aggregating catalogs from several independent operators requires the hosted Worker.

roles.label: Repository search
roles.summary: Rank and filter the public index by text, facets, activity, and cloneability.
roles.canonicalData: None. Results are derived from the catalog.
observability: response freshness, withheld, and budgets blocks
roles.failure: The endpoint answers 503 catalog_unavailable when no catalog can be read, never an empty result.
gaps: app/src/repository_index.py is standard-library Python, but only the Worker serves it; the gateway has no search route.

roles.label: Identity resolver
roles.summary: Resolve usernames, node keys, SSH keys, and browser sessions to verifiable public identities.

hosted.implementation: Python Worker accounts, SSH keys, WebFinger, and portable session grants

independentProfile.implementation: Node-local Ed25519 identity, SSH authorization broker in local mode, and router-key verification of portable sessions

optional.substitute: localAuthorization mode local with an operator-maintained grants file; nodes keep signing with their own key.

roles.canonicalData: Private keys stay on each device or node; the registry holds only public authority state.
roles.failure: In fallback mode the broker consults local grants only when the Worker is unreachable, never after a denial, so revocation cannot be bypassed by cutting the uplink.
gaps: Username registration, WebFinger, and minting portable session grants run only on the hosted Worker.
There is no HTTP resolver an independent operator can run for username-to-key lookups.

roles.label: Collaboration relay
roles.summary: Accept signed issues, pull requests, reviews, and discussions and commit them into repositories.

hosted.implementation: Python Worker collaboration inboxes and room Durable Objects

independentProfile.implementation: forkmesh-mirror-node native intake, gateway direct submissions, and SSH pull submission spool

optional.substitute: Contributors submit over SSH (forkmesh-pull-submit) or directly to the gateway; the signed records are committed on the node.

roles.canonicalData: Signed collaboration records under .forkmesh/ in the repository itself.
roles.failure: Submissions made while the Worker is down stay durable in the spool; nothing is acknowledged that was not committed.
gaps: Live rooms and chat run only in hosted Durable Objects.
Forwarding a spool to another node still names a controller API origin.

roles.label: Automation broker
roles.summary: Run repository workflows, record signed status checks, and dispatch agent jobs.

independentProfile.implementation: Desktop ActionRunner sandbox and signed forkmesh-check-v1 attestations

optional.substitute: Leave website agent jobs disabled; workflows and signed required checks run without them.

roles.canonicalData: Workflow files and signed check attestations in the repository; run logs on the runner host.

paths: actions run directory on the runner host

observability: run meta.json and log.txt per run
roles.failure: A missing check attestation keeps the merge gate closed; it never counts as success.
gaps: Workflows run only inside the Qt desktop; there is no headless runner service.
The agent job queue is hosted-only.

roles.label: Organization service
roles.summary: Create organizations, manage members and roles, and hand over ownership.

hosted.implementation: Python Worker organization authorization and succession

roles.canonicalData: Organization rows in the hosted D1 database.
roles.failure: Repositories owned by an organization stay cloneable from their mirrors; membership changes are unavailable.
gaps: No independent implementation; membership and roles are not yet repository-native records.
The authorization projection mirrors receive covers repository roles only, not organization administration.
